paragraphs: The M5 Competition is the high-performance variant of the F90-generation M5, produced from 2017 to 2024. It uses the S63 — a 4.4-litre twin-turbo V8 that's part of BMW's hot-vee turbo family, with the turbos positioned inside the V of the engine for faster spool and a more compact layout. The F90 M5 Competition was the most powerful M5 of its era before the current-generation G90 hybrid arrived, and remains a highly sought-after performance car — with the S63's hot-vee turbo layout bringing its own well-documented maintenance considerations.
about.boldParagraph: The M5 Competition is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
